description: A rule's recent runs, newest first: when it ran (schedule, manual, create or instant trigger), what it returned (rows, addresses), and the outcome: notified, no_rows, throttled (address alerted on within the throttle window), suppressed_blocked (already blocked), suppressed_trusted, no_ip (rows without an address), storm, auto_resolved (dismissed by an exclusion, trusted IP or verified bot), skipped or error. suppressedIps says which addresses were left out and why. Also nextRunAt for periodic rules. Quiet runs are kept 2 days, the rest 14.

since.description: Only runs since then: 30m, 1h, 2d or an ISO date.
